description: Defines the WindowInfo structure and related classes for describing window properties that can receive input in Android's GUI system.

classes.name: WindowInfo
classes.description: Represents properties of a window that can receive input, including flags, type, input configuration, and other attributes.

classes.name: WindowInfoHandle
classes.description: A handle for a WindowInfo object used by the native input dispatcher to refer to window manager objects.

methods.name: setInputConfig
methods.description: Sets the input configuration flags for the window.

methods.name: addTouchableRegion
methods.description: Adds a touchable region to the window's touchable region.

methods.name: touchableRegionContainsPoint
methods.description: Checks if a point is within the touchable region.

methods.name: frameContainsPoint
methods.description: Checks if a point is within the window's frame.

methods.name: supportsSplitTouch
methods.description: Determines if the window supports split touch.

methods.name: isSpy
methods.description: Checks if the window is a spy window.

methods.name: interceptsStylus
methods.description: Checks if the window intercepts stylus input.

methods.name: overlaps
methods.description: Checks if this window overlaps with another window.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality operator for comparing WindowInfo objects.

methods.name: writeToParcel
methods.description: Serializes the WindowInfo object into a Parcel.

methods.name: readFromParcel
methods.description: Deserializes the WindowInfo object from a Parcel.

methods.name: updateFrom
methods.description: Updates the handle's WindowInfo from another handle.

methods.name: releaseChannel
methods.description: Releases the channel used by the WindowInfo.
